args.body: Hi Lena, during a catalog query I discovered an error from the 2026-10-14 price update: 22 products under fixed-price contracts (P-1201 through P-1222) were mistakenly increased by 3%. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 through SO-77317) were placed at the inflated rates, resulting in an estimated total overcharge of $4,128.60. I recommend reverting the prices on these 22 SKUs immediately and reviewing order adjustments with sales/billing. Please let me know how you would like me to proceed.
